iti66:1.1: (Tik. II.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti66:2.1: Tīṇi-māni bhikkhave soceyyāni. Katamāni tīṇi? Kāyasoceyyaṃ vacīsoceyyaṃ manosoceyyaṃ, imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi soceyyānīti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti66:3.1: Kāyasuciṃ vācāsuciṃ cetosuciṃ-anāsavaṃ | sucisoceyyasampannaṃ āhu sabbapahāyinan-ti ||
iti66:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||7|| (Tik.
